about.text: Matchflare: calendar-subscription service for sport and esports fixtures; the esports section lists 22 leagues across games, with League entries LCK, LCK Challengers, LCS, LEC (EMEA), PCS, LPL, Worlds and LTA (League of The Americas); choose a competition to add all its games to a calendar or pick teams.
